blocks.text: Serverless MySQL platform with database branching

PlanetScale brings Vitess (the database technology that powers YouTube) to a developer-friendly platform. The result is MySQL that scales horizontally, handles non-blocking schema changes, and provides database branching - capabilities that traditionally required specialized database engineering teams.

Non-blocking schema changes are transformative for teams deploying frequently. PlanetScale applies schema changes without locking tables or causing downtime. You deploy schema changes like you deploy code - with confidence that your application remains available throughout.

The database branching workflow mirrors git: create a branch, make schema changes, test them, then merge back to production. This eliminates the risk of untested migrations and enables parallel development on database schema without conflicts.
Horizontal scaling with the same tech that powers YouTube
Git-like branching for schema development and testing
Schema migrations without table locks or downtime
Query analytics with slow query detection and optimization
HTTP-based driver for edge and serverless runtimes

PlanetScale's non-blocking schema changes and branching workflow make database operations as safe as code deployments. For teams using MySQL that need to deploy frequently without downtime risk, it is the best option.
Our engineers work with PlanetScale daily and can help you integrate it into your stack.
